mapas_mortality_improvement_ceiling_year: Правилник за таблиците на смртност (МАПАС, 177/2022), чл. 2: pension company MUST take expected future longevity improvement into account, but 'може да го продолжи очекуваното траење на живот НАЈМНОГУ до три години' - this is a CEILING on the adjustment, not a floor/requirement. This supports the paper's argument: if the data-implied improvement exceeds 3 years of e_x, the ceiling forces under-reflection, consistent with H2 (static/capped approaches understate the annuity factor). confirmed

table_standards_issued_aso_source: No dedicated ASO bylaw implementing the чл. 22(2)/(6) JOINT minimum standard (sex/age specification, numeric threshold, 2nd-pillar scope, cross-reference to чл.22/МАПАС) was located. But ASO's general Правилник за минималните стандарди за пресметка на техничките резерви, Сл. весник 318/2020 (archived: data/raw/aso/pravilnik-tehnicki-rezervi-sl-vesnik-318-2020.pdf, OCR text alongside), т. 5.3.3(2), DOES already require the probability of death to be 'соодветно коригирана... за очекуваните идни намалувања/зголемувања на смртноста' for contracts where falling mortality raises the reserve; т. 5.3.2(2)-(3) DOES already cap the reserving interest rate at the insurer's own 3y average return and the contractual guaranteed rate. So: qualitative improvement obligation + quantitative rate cap EXIST; the missing piece is specifically the Art.22(2)/(6) JOINT ASO/MAPAS standard. not found (narrowly, correctly scoped)
table_standards_issued_mapas_source: Правилник за правилата и минималните стандарди за таблиците на смртност, Сл. весник на РСМ бр. 177/2022 (mapas.mk, https://mapas.mk/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pravilnik-za-pravilata-i-minimalnite-standardi-za-tabliczite-na-smrtnost.pdf), implements чл. 22(3)/63(3) - covers PENSION COMPANIES only (programmed withdrawals). confirmed
